BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, hosiótēs is the word for holiness, piety. In Luke 1:75, the text says "In holiness and righteousness before him."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, hosiótēs means holiness, piety, nothing more and nothing less.
RelatedEvents: The Birth of John the Baptist
